features.name: ASEAN_DIKWP_OpenStudio_v1.0.0
features.title: OpenStudio · China–ASEAN
features.en: Learn with 12 Chinese/English/Vietnamese modules, four semantic labs and a portable student project.
features.zh: 通过中英越三语12个模块、四类语义实验和可导出作品学习与创新。

features.name: DIKWP-PACT-v0.1.0
features.title: PACT · Purpose and permission
features.en: Reproduce purpose, permission and evidence checks across 72 paired synthetic scenarios and four deterministic baselines.
features.zh: 在72个成对合成场景与四种确定性基线上复现意图、权限和证据检查。

features.name: DIKWP-MESH-
features.title: MESH² · Semantic transformations
features.en: Explore all 25 ordered D/I/K/W/P transformation classes, alternative semantic routes and observer disagreements.
features.zh: 探索D/I/K/W/P全部25类有序转换、多条语义路径与观察者分歧。

features.name: DIKWP-VERITYWEAVE-v2.0.0
features.title: VerityWeave · Evidence and context
features.en: Inspect evidence, context and incentives in an auditable semantic research system.
features.zh: 检查语义研究系统中的证据、语境与激励因素。

features.name: DIKWP-ASCENT-v0.2.0
features.title: ASCENT 0.2 · Numerical research
features.en: Study bounded numerical experiments, stronger-reference comparisons, explicit adoption, monitoring and rollback.
features.zh: 研究有界数值实验、强参考比较、明确采用、监测与回退。

features.name: DIKWP-PRAXIS-WorldGate-v2.0.0
features.title: WorldGate 2.0 · Authority and outcomes
features.en: Connect signed authority, atomic state changes, outcome observation and conditional compensation in a local inventory adapter.
features.zh: 在本地库存适配器中连接签名权限、原子状态变更、结果观测与有条件补偿。

features.name: DIKWP-CLEARPATH-TRANSPARENT-ECONOMY
features.title: ClearPath · Opportunity selection
features.en: Compare funded demand, opportunity selection, saturation and competing scenarios.
features.zh: 比较有资金支持的需求、机会选择、饱和度与竞争场景。

features.name: DIKWP-DEMANDPROOF-COMMONS
features.title: DemandProof · Shared capacity
features.en: Plan shared capacity and inspect signed task, acceptance and payment-observation records.
features.zh: 规划共享产能，检查签名任务、验收与付款观测记录。

features.name: DIKWP-LUCIDECON-OS
features.title: LucidEcon · Contribution and replay
features.en: Assess bounded opportunities, replay evidence receipts and allocate agreed contribution pools with exact accounting.
features.zh: 评估有界机会，重放证据记录，并精确核算约定的贡献池。

features.name: Complete-Information-Theoretic-Mathematics-Problem-to-Certificate-Compiler
features.title: CITM Forge · Mathematical certificates
features.en: Explore a downloadable mathematics research package and its problem-to-certificate workflow.
features.zh: 下载数学研究工具包，探索从问题到证书的处理流程。

features.name: DIKWP-Consciousness-Futures-Studio-V1
features.title: Consciousness Futures · Study design
features.en: Use the archived research studio to explore artificial-consciousness questions and study design.
features.zh: 使用研究工作台交付包探索人工意识问题与研究设计。
